entities.summary: The Widzew Łódź Stadium is a football stadium in Łódź, Poland. It is the home venue of Widzew Łódź. The stadium has an all-seater capacity of 18,018. The previous stadium had a capacity of 10,500 seats, with only part of the West Stand covered. It was demolished in early 2015 to make way for the new stadium.
